'''Bandin Dobah''' was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] at the head of a band of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He stole the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R4-W9]], who had an exceptional map of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] and [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]] of the region. His activities attracted the attention of [[Moruth Doole]] and [[Thakba Besadii Diori]]. Both placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head. A group of adventurers captured him on his [[Bandin Dobah's asteroid base|hideout]].
